releaseNotes: Fixed Google, Microsoft, Facebook and Apple sign-in in the Windows and Android apps — the sign-in now hands back to the app correctly
Android app can now be reopened from the browser after signing in
Android app now detects new versions and shows the update screen
Desktop app installs updates and restarts automatically when opened
Fixed the desktop update card not appearing
Google, Microsoft, Facebook and Apple sign-in now reliably return you to the app on every platform — the sign-in token reaches Sonora instead of being consumed by the browser tab
Android sign-in handoff fixed — Chrome no longer silently blocks the return to the app; a one-tap 'Open Sonora' button is shown as a fallback
Desktop fullscreen support — press F11 or use the toggle in the top bar for true OS-level fullscreen

Offline download integrity — on startup, every downloaded track is verified against its stored audio; if the OS evicted a track's bytes under storage pressure, it's cleanly removed instead of falsely showing as available offline
